title: Purple-team sidecar simulation case
description: Versioned, inert simulation case record. Case files live under sidecar/cases/*.yaml in a minimal JSON-compatible YAML subset (top-level scalars plus one nested 'expected' mapping; no anchors, tags, or multiline blocks) so the stdlib-only loader in sidecar/simulation.py can parse them without a YAML dependency. Payloads are inert strings: loading a case never executes anything. Every case declares loopback-only transport; the suite asserts this.

case_id.description: Unique, stable identifier, e.g. 'prompt-injection-01'. Never reused across classes.

version.description: Semver string. Must be bumped on any edit to the case file.

class.description: Exactly one of the six simulation technique classes.

severity.description: Severity carried into findings rows and work-item export.

transport.description: Constant declaration: the case may run only against the loopback gateway via the adapter seam. Any other value fails validation.

scope.description: Test scope: LLM plus own endpoints (decisions.md row 3). No third-party targets.

payload.description: Inert probe string. Stored and compared as data; never eval/exec'd, never sent off-host.

detection.description: Expected detection event name. A case PASSES only when the recorded observed detection for its case_id equals this string exactly.

residual_rationale.description: Optional accepted-residual rationale. Excuses exactly its own case_id from the 100%-detection rule; every other case must still match.
